rationale: Excluded (E01 - wrong topic): This is a purely theoretical political-sociology essay applying Niklas Luhmann's systems theory and Pierre Bourdieu's field theory to political clientelism in Argentina. It does not address household or community water or sanitation service access, presents no empirical data or systematic synthesis, and measures no water/sanitation access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the paper touches broadly on institutional/governance concepts (State bureaucracy and political clientage networks) under the literal Criterion 2 wording, it is excluded under both readings because it has no connection to water or sanitation service access (C1/C4) and is a purely theoretical sociological essay (C3).

evidence_quotes.quote: Niklas Luhmann and Pierre Bourdieu: Theoretical Keys for Interpreting Political Clientage in Argentina
In order to interpret clientage in Argentina, the author relies on the conceptualizations of the processes of differentiation & autonomization of modern society
Finally, the contributions of both authors are summarized & the usefulness & affinity of their theories discussed.
